slides.title: Memory Reduction with __slots__
slides.prompt: What primary memory optimization does defining `__slots__` on a custom Python class achieve?
options: It suppresses creation of instance __dict__, saving significant per-object memory overhead
It forces the object to be stored in CPU L1 cache
It converts all instance variables to C pointers
It disables garbage collection for that class
slides.correctAnswer: It suppresses creation of instance __dict__, saving significant per-object memory overhead

slides.title: PyPy JIT Engine vs CPython
slides.prompt: Why can PyPy achieve significant execution speedups over standard CPython for pure Python loops?
options: It uses a Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler to convert Python bytecode to native machine code dynamically
It completely removes all type assertions at runtime
It runs Python exclusively on GPU cores
It automatically compiles Python to Rust source code
slides.correctAnswer: It uses a Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler to convert Python bytecode to native machine code dynamically
